## How to Use This Site

This site presents the **complete figure catalogue** from the Health Economic Evaluation (HEE) evidence mapping project, organized thematically into **six narrative acts** (following the Companion register structure) plus the **Funder Decision Pack**, **Timeline set**, **Map Atlas**, and **Lancet Paper Figures**.

### For Each Figure You Can:

| Action | How |
|--------|-----|
| **Vote** | Click 👍 / 👎 on any figure — your votes are stored locally in your browser |
| **Comment** | Highlight any text and click the **hypothes.is** icon (top-right) to annotate |
| **View full-size** | Click any figure to open in lightbox |
| **See the code** | Each figure shows its generating script (`R/fig-*.R`) |

### Thematic Organization

| Act | Theme | Figures | Focus |
|-----|-------|---------|-------|
| **Act I** | Field Shape | 4 | How much research, growth, evaluation types |
| **Act II** | Topic & Disease | 6 | What is studied, disease areas, interventions |
| **Act III** | Methods & Quality | 7 | Evaluation types, model vs measurement, decision-usefulness |
| **Act IV** | Geography & Authorship | 8 | Where evidence is, who produces it, collaboration |
| **Act V** | Gaps vs Burden | 8 | Evidence per DALY, disease mismatches, deficits, inequality |
| **Act VI** | Bibliometrics | 4 | Open access, journals, funders, language |
| **Funder Pack** | Decision-ready | 5 | Opportunity matrix, scorecard, capacity, trajectory, funder landscape |
| **Timelines** | Change over time | 5 | Equity, QALY, reach, methods, decision-framing trends |
| **Map Atlas** | Cartographic | 9 | Burden-intensity, bivariate, deserts, authorship, methods, disease |
| **Paper Figures** | Lancet core | 8 | The 6+2 figures for the journal submission |

## Data Quality Notes

All figures reflect **audited, corrected data** as of **2026-09-08**:

- ✅ Income classification: World Bank API (fixed 30% Natural Earth error rate)
- ✅ Population: World Bank 2025 (fixed up to 93% underestimation for fast-growing countries)
- ✅ CUA/CEA harmonisation: QALY/DALY outcomes → Cost-utility (per extraction rule)
- ✅ DOI de-duplication: 200 duplicate DOIs removed
- ⚠️ Geography: **Extracted-only** for income figures (affiliation proxy is income-biased — see [DATA_QUALITY_AUDIT.md](../DATA_QUALITY_AUDIT.md))
- ⚠️ MeSH coverage: 63% C-tree, 57% E-tree, 62% N-tree (harvest 2020–2026 only; 2010–2019 harvest running)
